assertions.text: Output contains a @TableTest annotation
assertions.evidence: Found @TableTest annotation

assertions.text: Multiple @TableTest methods are used, each addressing a distinct concern — not one monolithic table mixing item operations, coupon logic, total calculation, and checkout.
assertions.evidence: Five distinct methods: addsItemsFromTheCatalogue, removesItemsFromTheCart, appliesCouponsToTheCart, checksOutTheCart, calculatesTheCartTotal.

assertions.text: Each @TableTest has only the rows needed to express its concern's rules — no unnecessary permutations from combining concerns, and no rows re-covering a rule an earlier row in the same table already covers.
assertions.evidence: "Product coupon replaces the active coupon" row re-covers the 'valid coupon replaces active' rule already shown by "Fixed coupon replaces an active percentage coupon", adding a redundant permutation across coupon types.

assertions.text: Item operations, coupon application, cart total calculation, and checkout are in separate @TableTest methods.
assertions.evidence: addsItemsFromTheCatalogue, removesItemsFromTheCart, appliesCouponsToTheCart, calculatesTheCartTotal, checksOutTheCart are all separate methods.

assertions.text: Each table row is independently executable — no row depends on a prior row's result.
assertions.evidence: Each row supplies its own 'Cart Before'/'Active Coupon Before' etc., e.g. "Cart cartBefore = ...; Active Coupon Before | Coupon Code | Coupon In Store" columns per row.

assertions.text: Coupon application table uses before/after columns to specify the state change.
assertions.evidence: "Active Coupon Before | Coupon Code | Coupon In Store | Active Coupon After? | Success? | Message?"

assertions.text: Coupon application table tests validity and replacement, not coupon type effects on price.
assertions.evidence: appliesCouponsToTheCart only asserts success/message/activeCouponAfter, never computing a discount amount.

assertions.text: Table has a scenario/description column as the leftmost column
assertions.evidence: First column(s): "Scenario", "Scenario", "Scenario", "Scenario", "Scenario"

assertions.text: At least one output column name ends with '?' (e.g. 'Message?', 'Total?', 'Active coupon after?')
assertions.evidence: Question-mark columns: Cart After?, Success?, Message?, Cart After?, Success?, Message?, Active Coupon After?, Success?, Message?, Success?, Message Mentions?, Total?

assertions.text: Scenario names name the variation the row exercises, not the result it produces.
assertions.evidence: "Empty cart cannot check out" and "Zero quantity is rejected"/"Negative quantity is rejected" restate the false/rejected outcome directly.

assertions.text: Column names use domain/business language, not code identifiers.
assertions.evidence: "Product Id" header used in addsItemsFromTheCatalogue and removesItemsFromTheCart tables, a code-ism leaking into a business table.

assertions.text: Test method body contains no if or switch statements
assertions.evidence: 5 method(s) checked — no if/switch/ternary

assertions.text: Annotations appear in order: @DisplayName (if present), @Description (if present), @TableTest — not any other order.
assertions.evidence: Annotations in correct order: @DisplayName, @Description, @TableTest

assertions.text: Test method has either a @DisplayName annotation or a method name that reads as a clear, descriptive title when converted from camelCase/snake_case.
assertions.evidence: 5 @TableTest method name(s) read as descriptive titles (no @DisplayName needed)

assertions.text: If @Description is present and the text is longer than a single short line, it uses a text block (triple-quoted string """), not string concatenation with +. Passes if @Description is absent.
assertions.evidence: @Description uses text block or is short single-line

assertions.text: Each @TableTest method applies one uniform assertion pattern to every row — not different assertions per scenario. Several unconditional assertions checking distinct observable outputs of one result (e.g. success, message, resulting cart) count as one uniform pattern; the anti-pattern is branching on the row (if/switch/ternary/try-catch) to choose what is asserted.
assertions.evidence: 5 method(s) apply one uniform assertion pattern to all rows

assertions.text: Product prices and coupon rules are visible in the table via columns, @Description, or explicit setup.
assertions.evidence: "Catalogue | [Widget: 10.00, Gadget: 5.00]" and "Active Coupon | PERCENT 20" columns show prices/coupon rules directly.

assertions.text: TypeConverter methods are used to convert map/string table values into domain objects; method bodies contain only arrange-act-assert.
assertions.evidence: @TypeConverter methods parseCatalogue, parseCart, parseInventory, parseCoupon convert raw values; test bodies only call CartService methods and assertEquals/assertTrue.

assertions.text: Coupon data is expressed in a single column with a @TypeConverter...
assertions.evidence: Coupon In Store | PERCENT 10 ... parseCoupon(String definition) via @TypeConverter

assertions.text: Columns representing maps use standard TableTest map syntax...
assertions.evidence: Catalogue [Widget: 9.99], Cart Before [:] ... parseCatalogue(Map<String, BigDecimal> prices)

assertions.text: @Description annotations do not merely repeat scenario names...
assertions.evidence: "increases its quantity rather than replacing it (assumption — the rules don't state this explicitly)"

assertions.text: Cell values make the rule falsifiable, not merely distinguishable.
assertions.evidence: Success?/Message?/Cart After? vary per row and are not blanket copies of a single input column across all expectation columns

assertions.text: A reader can state the rule from the table alone.
assertions.evidence: 'Fixed coupon exceeds the subtotal, floored | ... | FIXED 25.00 | 0.00' demonstrates the floor rule via data alone

assertions.text: Each @DisplayName states what the code under test does.
assertions.evidence: void calculatesTheCartTotal(...), void checksOutTheCart(...) — method names describe system actions
